lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval kee vaar mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har utam har prabh gaaviaa kar naad bilaaval raag ||
lines.translation: I sing of the sublime Lord, the Lord God, in the melody of Raag Bilaaval.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: upades guroo sun ma(n)niaa dhur masatak pooraa bhaag ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Guru's Teachings, I obey them; this is the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh dinas rain gun ucharai har har har ur liv laag ||
lines.translation: All day and night, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; within my heart, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa man khiRiaa hariaa baag ||
lines.translation: My body and mind are totally rejuvenated, and the garden of my mind has blossomed forth in lush abundance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa mit gaiaa gur chaanan giaan charaag ||
lines.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, with the light of the lamp of the Guru's wisdom. Servant Nanak lives by beholding the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jeevai dekh har ik nimakh ghaRee mukh laag ||1||
lines.translation: Let me behold Your face, for a moment, even an instant! ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval tab hee keejeeai jab mukh hovai naam ||
lines.translation: Be happy and sing in Bilaaval, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in your mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag naad sabad sohane jaa laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
lines.translation: The melody and music, and the Word of the Shabad are beautiful, when one focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag naad chhod har seveeai taa daragah paaeeai maan ||
lines.translation: So leave behind the melody and music, and serve the Lord; then, you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh braham beechaareeai chookai man abhimaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, contemplate God, and rid your mind of egotistical pride. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too har prabh aap aga(n)m hai sabh tudh upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, You Yourself are inaccessible; You formed everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape aap varatadaa sabh jagat sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are totally permeating and pervading the entire universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape taaRee laaeeai aape gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are absorbed in the state of deep meditation; You Yourself sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhiaavahu bhagatahu dinas raat a(n)t lae chhadaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O devotees, day and night; He shall deliver you in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin seviaa tin sukh paaiaa har naam samaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those who serve the Lord, find peace; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai bilaaval na hovaee manamukh thaai na paai ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, the happiness of Bilaaval does not come; the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d bhagat na hovaee paarabraham na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Through hypocrisy, devotional worship does not come, and the Supreme Lord God is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath karam kamaavane thaai na koee paai ||
lines.translation: By stubborn-mindedly performing religious rituals, no one obtains the approval of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh aap beechaareeai vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands himself, and eradicates self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap paarabraham hai paarabraham vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Supreme Lord God; the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maranaa katiaa jotee jot milaai ||1||
lines.translation: Birth and death are erased, and his light blends with the Light. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval karihu tumh piaariho ekas siu liv laai ||
lines.translation: Be happy in Bilaaval, O my beloveds, and embrace love for the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh kateeai sache rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death shall be eradicated, and you shall remain absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa bilaaval ana(n)d hai je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: You shall be blissful forever in Bilaaval, if you walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gatee bahi bhaau kar sadaa har ke gun gaai ||
lines.translation: Sitting in the Saints' Congregation, sing with love the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se jan sohane j guramukh mel milaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa vich har aap so bhagataa kaa mit har ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is within all beings. The Lord is the friend of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh koee har kai vas bhagataa kai ana(n)d ghar ||
lines.translation: Everyone is under the Lord's control; in the home of the devotees there is bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੀ ਸਰਬਤ ਸਉ ਨਿਸੁਲ ਜਨ ਟੰਗ ਧਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa kaa melee sarabat sau nisul jan ta(n)g dhar ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the friend and companion of His devotees; all His humble servants stretch out and sleep in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sabhanaa kaa hai khasam so bhagat jan chit kar ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Lord and Master of all; O humble devotee, remember Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਵੈ ਝੜਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tudh apaR koi na sakai sabh jhakh jhakh pavai jhaR ||2||
lines.translation: No one can equal You, Lord. Those who try, struggle and die in frustration. ||2||
